t: The 4lite Kana is a fixed fire-rated LED downlight designed to provide versatile, reliable illumination in residential and commercial properties. This white IP65-rated fitting is ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and retail spaces. It provides easy selection between 5W and 7W power outputs, as well as 4 colour temperatures ranging from 2700K to 6000K. The unit features a 30, 60, and 90-minute fire rating for enhanced safety. A transparent terminal cover allows quick verification of cable connections, while the integrated LED driver ensures a reliable 60,000 hour lifespan. Includes detachable connector block and twist-on bezel.
b: Transparent Terminal Cover Allows Quick Connection Checks
